 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 19-01-2023 Heard learned counsel for the State.
This case was taken up at 10:30 A.M. when no one appeared.
Once again at 01:00 P.M. on call, no one appeared on behalf of the petitioners.

The petitioners have moved before this Court under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing of the order dated 31.05.2016 passed by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Jamui in Complain Case No.1955C/2015 by which summons were issued against the petitioners and other accused persons under Section 323,498A, 120B of the Indian Penal Code and  Dowry Prohibition Act.

As per the case, after the marriage, within six months Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.13293 of 2018(2) dt.19-01-2023 of her conjugal life the husband and inlaws started pressuring her for dowry and during pregnancy she was tortured for Rs.1,00,000/- and when in 2011 the case under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code was lodged, the husband appeared and assured to keep her wife with full dignity and honour but thereafter he went for second marriage with one Putul Devi.

Upon Birendra Mahto And Anr vs State Of Bihar And Anr on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183412458/
1 protest, she was assaulted and thrown out of the house.
